after.rosterkit/seating.py:
# owner: platform
"""Seat students in rows, sorted by last name."""

from typing import List
from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

def _check(students: list, seats: int) -> None:
    if seats <= 0:
        raise ProjectError("seats per row must be positive")
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to seat")

def _sort_key(student: Student) -> tuple:
    last = student.last_name.lower()
    return (last, student.first_name.lower())

def _render(number: int, group: List[Student]) -> str:
    names = " | ".join(item.display_name for item in group)
    return f"Row {number}: {names}"

def _split(items: list, size: int) -> list:
    stops = range(0, len(items), size)
    return [items[pos:pos + size] for pos in stops]

# ---
def seat_rows(students: list, seats: int) -> List[str]:
    """Return one line of text per row of seats."""
    _check(students, seats)
    ordered = sorted(students, key=_sort_key)
    groups = _split(ordered, seats)
    pairs = enumerate(groups, 1)
    return [_render(*pair) for pair in pairs]
